mode: Independent static integration review plus exact local byte/hash, ZIP inventory and provenance checks; no Torch import or CUDA execution.
remote_dependency_scope: All ten task-relative paths were mapped to frozen local source/weight bytes. The controller independently rechecks their actual remote paths/hashes before any stage. This review did not perform a remote read.

synthetic_gate_controls.scope: Synthetic metadata rejection and actual local flock semantics; no Torch/CUDA/model computation

resolved_findings: Task-wide single-owner EX campaign lock and inherited shared environment lock prevent competing owners after parent death.
Actual allocator getter must equal 0.5; fixed runtime profile and source hashes are rechecked at stage boundaries.
External full-B audit accepts only explicitly bound current-process wrapper evidence when Torch is preimported.
Runtime profiles, audit claims/progress/terminal results and controller publications fsync parent directory entries.
Physical GPU energy completeness requires 170 completed rows and an interval-complete finite nonnegative reading under the exact declared GPU UUID counter.
Stage launch PID/process-group receipts and unique output directories retain ownership evidence.
disposition: No remaining blocking defect found in this exact local bundle. It is suitable for the already authorized isolated deployment and gated wait; experiment admission still requires actual READY, strict tests, full-shape and parity gates.
